scope: Every181 unique source in the four Live GPS Test scenarios. All sources are allowed for fitting and model selection, at the user's explicit request.
evaluation_population: Demo fit/conformance only. Never call this held-out accuracy, generalization or zero real-world error.
data: Actual prepared camera pixels, aligned PDS XYZ/XYE, individually adjudicated geometry candidates, source-checked manual interiors and reviewed stationary-scene template transfers. No semantic model predictions used as labels. Unknown and uncertain boundaries255.
class4: Other visible rock with unverified physical size, retained in semantic labels and ignored255 in four-class navigation. Ground0 is the original ground/small-stone composite, not a definite negative for all-rock appearance.
model: Start from original v11 navigation checkpoint. Fine-tune only its separate navigation encoder and four-class head. Global terrain model file and weights stay unchanged. No frame-ID lookup or manual-mask substitution at inference.

training.crops: Full frame or moderate384/640/1024 context crops. No128-to512 enlargement. Native256px Navcam remains256px source content.
training.loss: Pixel provenance weighting; CE class weights[1,3,1.5,1],0.35 Dice,0.75 ground-as-rock,0.75 hardware-as-rock,0.5 ground-as-hardware,1.0 rock recall,0.5 hardware recall.
training.selection: Maximum demo score among epochs retaining all baseline-found manual rock-region proxies and at most0.02 obstacle pixel recall loss. Initial checkpoint eligible. Also save best unconstrained score for diagnosis, never automatic promotion.

policy.region_hit: At least10% of the final reviewed class1 core within a region bbox, with minimum3native pixels. Regions are annotation proxies, not a count of unique physical objects.

zero_error_goal: Try to eliminate reviewed demo false alarms while preserving rock detections. Report exact remaining errors and annotation coverage; partial masks and weak geometry cannot prove zero error over full images or driving safety.
rollback: Keep original navigation ONNX and checkpoint, historical datasets and all previous result records immutable. Do not deploy a failed candidate.
